campaigns.name: The Tideglass Lantern
campaigns.premise: On the salt flats of Oris, a lighthouse shines inland once every thirteen nights. Its light reveals streets from a town nobody remembers building.
campaigns.notes:
An original, system-neutral mystery about memory, shared promises, and a changing coastline.
Table agreement: keep peril adventurous; pause or fade out any scene that makes someone uncomfortable.
Questions for the table: What did you leave at sea? Who remembers your first name?

sessions.title: A street beneath the salt
sessions.summary: The travelers arrived at Bellwether Quay as the tideglass lantern turned inland. A street of blue doors appeared across the flats. Sera offered a map with a blank center.
sessions.notes:
Opening image: a paper boat circles a dry fountain.
Discoveries: the blue doors bear tomorrow's dates; the lighthouse keeper has not been seen for three nights.
Decision: follow the bell rope beneath the quay before crossing the flats.
sessions.nextSteps: Ask who recognizes the song from the dry fountain. Let the group choose whether to visit Iven's workshop or the exposed street first.

sessions.title: The keeper's unwritten letter
sessions.notes: Preparation: Iven has a sealed envelope containing only salt. When held near the lantern, a sentence appears: 'Return what we agreed to forget.'
sessions.nextSteps: Find out whose promise powers the lantern. Offer a quiet negotiation before any dangerous crossing.

npcs.name: Sera Venn
npcs.notes:
Wears a coat lined with failed maps. Wants to find her brother's workshop, which vanished from every street but not from her memory.
Voice: exact directions, uncertain names.
Secret: she drew the lantern's first inland path.

npcs.name: Iven of the Copper Hands
npcs.notes:
Repairs small objects without asking payment. Wants the quay's bell to ring once more.
Carries copper gloves to hide the blue salt on his fingertips. Knows the keeper left willingly.

locations.name: Bellwether Quay
locations.description: A harbor stranded above a retreating sea. Wind threads the empty mooring rings and makes them hum.
locations.notes:
Sensory cues: warm stone, kelp smoke, a bell rope dropping through a locked hatch.
Useful detail: the tide table contains a thirteenth column.

locations.name: The Quiet Foundry
locations.description: A roofless workshop where unfinished bells collect rainwater that never evaporates.
locations.notes: Iven keeps the smallest bell wrapped in a map. A blue door appears behind the furnace when the inland beam passes.

hooks.title: Who is ringing beneath the quay?
hooks.notes: The bell rope moves at noon, though the bell was sold years ago. A fresh knot bears Sera's initials.

hooks.title: The town missing from the maps
hooks.notes: Choose a door on the salt flats. Each remembers a different version of the travelers' arrival.

hooks.title: A berth for the night
hooks.notes: The quay steward offered the old signal room after the travelers repaired its shutter.
